notes_for_editor: Thin record. The only tower-specific source is an OpenStreetMap node (358964625) that gives a name, an observation-tower tag, an elevation value of 471 with no unit shown, and an edit age; it gives no builder, date, owner or status. The story therefore states no unit. Wikipedia is used only for the community name match, and the node's coordinates (33.411562, -86.207525) were not matched to Renfroe's location in any source. Two WebSearch calls and one more Wikipedia read found no historic register, agency, newspaper or photo record for a Renfroe lookout; the NHLR crawl cache has no Renfroe entry. A real-estate listing (landsearch.com) gives an address on Renfroe Tower Road in Talladega; it may hint at a tower but is not used. Brief status 'unknown' is kept. The story is shorter than the 120-word floor because the evidence is one map entry plus a name match.
